#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    int T = 1;
    const long long MOD = 1000000007;

    int P, K;
    cin >> P >> K;

    vector<long long> k(P);
    for (int x = 0; x < P; ++x) {
        k[x] = (long long)K * x % P;
    }

    if (K == 0) {
        long long ans = 1;
        for (int i = 0; i < P - 1; ++i) {
            ans = (ans * P) % MOD;
        }
        cout << ans % MOD << "\n";
        return 0;
    }

    vector<bool> visited(P, false);
    vector<int> cycle_counts(P, 0);
    long long result = 1;

    for (int start = 0; start < P; ++start) {
        if (visited[start]) continue;
        int length = 0;
        int current = start;
        while (!visited[current]) {
            visited[current] = true;
            current = k[current];
            ++length;
        }
        cycle_counts[length]++;
    }

    for (int length = 1; length < P; ++length) {
        int count = cycle_counts[length];
        if (count != 0) {
            long long total = (long long)length * count + (length > 1 ? 1 : 0);
            long long power_base = total % MOD;
            long long power_exp = count;
            long long pow_result = 1;
            long long base = power_base;
            long long exp = power_exp;
            while (exp > 0) {
                if (exp & 1) {
                    pow_result = (pow_result * base) % MOD;
                }
                base = (base * base) % MOD;
                exp >>= 1;
            }
            result = (result * pow_result) % MOD;
        }
    }

    cout << result % MOD << "\n";

    return 0;
}
